requirements: R1: Prevent tasks from being marked as 'done' when their corresponding GitHub PRs are closed without being merged.

slices.title: Patch PR sync logic for unmerged closures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync patch for this epic, I want to use atomically-guarded state transitions for unmerged PR closures, so that false positive done states are eliminated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to a GitHub PR
When the PR is closed without being merged
Then the task status update must not mark the task as 'done'
Given a state transition update based on PR status
When saving the new status to the database
Then the update must use atomically-guarded statements like UPDATE WHERE id AND status
Given the need for verification
When running backend unit and integration tests
Then tests must verify both the unmerged PR state handling and the atomic update logic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive done statuses for unmerged PRs to 0%
